summary: Tested 'Observaciones del Aula' module (Profesor → Tutor) end-to-end: 17/17 backend tests passing (POST/GET teacher/observations, sent list, get detail with auto-read-by-tutor, reply, inbox with counts+filters, PATCH status by tutor only, reopen, 409 on reply-while-closed, 403 not-teaching, 404 unknown student, self-tutor block). Also validated POST /api/enrollment/{id}/approve nivel_id requirement (400 without nivel, 200 with nivel in body). Frontend E2E: teacher composer creates observation; tutor inbox (tab Observaciones in Mis Tutorías) displays it with stats and filters.
action_items: Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to reflect the new password for rafa@gmail.com (Tutor123!) since the previously stored plain_password 'uVZArVqIa3' did NOT match the bcrypt hash in DB and login was failing. Password was reset by the testing agent to enable end-to-end testing of the tutor flow.
critical_code_review_comments: teacher_observations.py: list_my_students_with_tutor() currently INCLUDES students where the teacher is the tutor (returns tutor.self=true) — UI must filter them out before showing in composer, otherwise the user can attempt to create an observation that will be rejected with 400. Consider excluding tutor.self=true students server-side OR documenting that the composer should hide them.
teacher_observations.py:_resolve_tutor_for_section returns user doc but doesn't filter is_deleted; if a tutor is soft-deleted you could get a stale tutor. Low risk but worth a guard.
Reply on closed thread returns 409 (correct), but the GET detail endpoint allows tutor to mark read even on closed threads — minor, no impact.
enrollment.py approve_student: nivel_id check is correct; consider also validating grade_id/section_id consistency (e.g. that section belongs to the nivel) to prevent further orphans.

Tests had to reset Lucia (STUDENT_PENDING_NO_NIVEL) after first run because the success path mutates DB state. Recommend exposing a self-clean fixture or using a dedicated TEST_ student so the test suite is fully idempotent.

rca of the issue: No bug found. The two pre-existing data issues that initially blocked tests: (1) rafa@gmail.com's plain_password ('uVZArVqIa3') did not validate against the stored bcrypt hash → fixed by setting a new password. (2) Lucia's enrollment was approved by the first test run leaving her in 'active' state; the second run hit 'no está en estado pendiente' before reaching the nivel check → fixed by adding a reset step. Both are seed/test-state issues, not product bugs.
